$comment: One fault per file. 'stage' is where the fault must be caught: 'parse' = the text is not YAML/JSON; 'structure' = it parses but violates the OpenAPI document structure; 'resolve' = a $ref cannot be resolved; 'semantic' = structurally valid but still wrong. 'pointer' is the JSON Pointer of the offending node, or of the parent when the fault is a missing key. Finding codes are not fixed yet; tests should assert on stage and pointer until the spec doctor defines them.

missing-paths-3.0.yaml.fault: required field 'paths' missing (3.0 only; legal in 3.1)

missing-responses-3.0.yaml.fault: required field 'responses' missing on an operation (3.0 only; legal in 3.1)

wrong-type-paths.yaml.fault: 'paths' is an array, expected an object

wrong-type-info-version.yaml.fault: 'info.version' is a number, expected a string

wrong-type-parameters.yaml.fault: 'parameters' is an object, expected an array

circular-ref.yaml.fault: A -> B -> A is a pure $ref cycle that never reaches a schema (not the same as a legal recursive schema)

external-ref.yaml.fault: $ref points at a remote URL; the engine has no I/O and must report it, not fetch it

duplicate-operation-id.yaml.fault: operationId 'ping' is used by two operations
